content:
alok: after 02:42 UTC deploy (release-7.0.1) embeddings p95 jumped ~100ms -> ~1.1s. Deployed 3m ago. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeds/summary

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: embeddings.p95 = 1.1s (>500ms). Autorevert suppressed due to change-window. Suggested: staged pin or per-tenant reroute.

jen: oncall: traces show a kv-cache miss burst + several large batches from tenant 'omega'. Looks tenant-amplified.

mike: we can reroute omega and apply a short regional pin. Commands: `redwood route update --tenant omega --route embeddings --to release-7.0.0 --now` then `redwood pin set --route embeddings --version release-7.0.0 --duration 45m`

ops-lead: approved. Jen, run the commands and notify CS. If p95 stays >300ms for 20m after pin, escalate to full rollback at 23:50 UTC.

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant reroute and regional pin applied by jen at 2026-04-10T02:48:10Z. Monitoring.

eve: quick check: pinned slice p95 ~150ms; omega tenant ~130ms. Opening ticket INF-9999 with traces and deploy diff.

alok: CS blurb: "We routed a subset of traffic to a prior stable release to reduce latency for impacted requests. Investigation ongoing; no customer data exposure."

jen: leaving runbook snippet in INF-9999 with the exact commands and rollback steps. Keeping thread active until ticket resolves.
